# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Origin:** Backlund
- **Role:** Pirate sailor, Former dock worker

## Appearance

Barney Pullen had the rugged look of a typical Backlund dock laborer turned rough sea sailor. His appearance reflected years of hard physical labor and exposure to harsh maritime elements.

## Personality

Barney was a relatively straightforward individual who sought a better livelihood away from the impoverishment of Backlund's lower class. Though involved in illicit maritime activities, he retained ties to his home and family.

## Traits

- Hardworking
- Desperate for better fortune

## Abilities

- Seamanship and physical labor skills

## Goals

- Earn money at sea to support his family in Backlund

## History

Barney Pullen left the docks of Backlund to seek his fortune at sea, eventually joining a crew involved in piratical operations. During his time away, his family in Backlund remained in poor conditions. His disappearance and eventual death became connected to broader investigations into dark occult rituals and human trafficking networks operating along the coast and trade routes.

## Background by volume

- Originally worked around the docks of Backlund before leaving to join a crew at sea
